description: This file defines the ClaimEvent entity class for the OrangeHRM system, including properties, ORM mappings, and getter/setter methods for claim event data.

classes.name: ClaimEvent
classes.description: An entity class representing a claim event, with properties like id, name, description, associated user, status, and deletion flag, using Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the claim event.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the claim event.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the claim event.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the claim event.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the claim event, if any.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the claim event.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status (active/inactive) of the claim event.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the claim event.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the claim event is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deleted flag of the claim event.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user associated with the claim event.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Associates a user with the claim event.
